title: [IMP2-13] History reads and blob uploads exist only on the optional JMAP sync API
description: Review finding IMP2-13: History reads and blob uploads exist only on the optional JMAP sync API (lens IMP2). Location: spec/10-relays.md:579-580 (§10.4.3 list), :636; spec/11-transport.md:173, :389, :507-513. Fix: The decision follows from existing text. 11-transport.md:12 ("JMAP is used only for history and blobs") and the §11.8.8 table (history and blob upload: JMAP yes, live stream no) already settle it. Fix: add "Implement the JMAP sync API (`jmap-sync-v1`, §11.8)" to the §10.4.3 MUST list; change 10:636 "through the live protocol and the JMAP sync API" to "through the JMAP sync API"; state that the upload response `blobId` is the CID text form of the uploaded bytes. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
